title: Ordinary scalar transport implies unbounded scalar transport
statement: For ring sheaves A,B on sites J,K, objects c,d, a ring isomorphism e:A(c)≅B(d), and an additive equivalence E:Mod(A)≌Mod(B) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], consider the ordinary scalar compatibility of [def-zl-generic-component-data]: the ordinary left-adjoint squares from discrete rings and from sheafified constant commutative rings, the latter through an additive equivalence ER on constant-ring module sheaves preserving constant realization [def-sfb-site-derived-constant-module-functor]. A normalized structural ring map and terminal test-object isomorphism, with E left adjoint to its pushforward, supplies the discrete-ring clause from the constant-ring clause. Given ordinary compatibility, E induces an unbounded derived equivalence ED with its canonical Q-factorization, and GenericComponentScalarCompatibility(A,B,c,d,e,ED) of [def-zl-generic-component-data] holds, with all the independent derived-category universes retained.

proof.text: Use the exact equivalence E to get ED=E.mapDerivedCategory and its Q-factorization. For discrete R-modules, apply the left-derived square lemma with source equivalence the identity; remove its derived identity factor by mapDerivedCategoryIdIso.

proof.text: For commutative R take ER from ordinary compatibility and apply the same left-derived square lemma to ER and E. Constant realization is exact. Localize its ordinary comparison with ER using mapDerivedCategoryCompIso and mapDerivedCategoryNatIso, and paste this with the scalar-extension derived square using associators. This is precisely the constant-presentation clause of GenericComponentScalarCompatibility.

lean.statement:
theorem generic_component_derived_scalar_transport
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    {J : GrothendieckTopology C} {K : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (A : Sheaf J RingCat.{u + 1}) (B : Sheaf K RingCat.{u + 1})
    (c : C) (d : D) (e : A.obj.obj (op c) ≅ B.obj.obj (op d))
    (E : ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} A ≌ ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} B)
    [E.functor.Additive]
    (h : GenericComponentOrdinaryScalarCompatibility A B c d e E)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wS} (ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} A)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wV} (ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} B)] :
    ∃ ED : DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} A) ≌
        DerivedCategory (ringedSiteModules.{u + 1} B),
      Nonempty (DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ ED.functor ≅
        E.functor.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q) ∧
      GenericComponentScalarCompatibility.{u, wR, wS, wV, wCJ, wCK} A B c d e ED
